tools.name: denext_check_snippet
tools.description: Check a denext code snippet for Next.js→denext mistakes (wrong import source, misplaced "use client", missing client boundary). Run this on code you are about to write.

params.name: code
params.description: The .ts/.tsx source to check.

tools.name: denext_explain_error
tools.description: Explain a TypeScript / Deno / denext-lint diagnostic in plain language with a concrete fix and a codeframe: collapses long generic assignability chains (defineApi, useApi, createApiClient) to the one mismatching property path, says why a value may be null/undefined, lists a switch's missing union members, maps react / next/* imports to denext, and suggests the nearest route, param or module for a typo. Pass `output` (what `deno check`, `deno lint`, `denext build` or the dev overlay printed) or one `diagnostic`. The original diagnostic is always included.

params.name: output
params.description: Tool output holding one or more diagnostics (deno check / deno lint / a build error).

params.name: diagnostic
params.description: One structured diagnostic: { code (2322 or "denext/rules-of-hooks"), message (a string, or TypeScript's { messageText, next } chain), file, line, column, length }.

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory the paths are relative to (default: .)

tools.name: denext_import_map
tools.description: Map a Next.js/React import specifier to its denext equivalent. Omit `specifier` to get the whole table.

params.name: specifier
params.description: A Next.js/React specifier, e.g. "next/navigation" or "react".

tools.name: denext_generate
tools.description: Scaffold a denext artifact into a project (writes files). kind = page|route|layout|loading|error|not-found|component|api|action|middleware|job|function|test|docker|migration|vector-search|seed|ci. Existing files are never overwritten unless force is set; pass dryRun to see the planned files and their contents without writing anything.

params.name: kind
params.description: page|route|layout|loading|error|not-found|component|api|action|middleware|job|function|test|docker|migration|vector-search|seed|ci

params.name: name
params.description: Route/component/action/migration name (optional for docker, seed and ci, where it overrides the detected flavor).

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: current directory).

params.name: force
params.description: Overwrite files that already exist.

params.name: dryRun
params.description: Plan only: print what would be written.

params.name: postgres
params.description: docker only (--postgres / --no-postgres): Postgres 17 service + DATABASE_URL (detected: @denext/backend / a Postgres URL). true adds it, false leaves it out, omitted follows the detection.

params.name: pgvector
params.description: docker only (--pgvector / --no-pgvector): Use the pgvector/pgvector:pg17 image (detected: the vector extension in migrations/). true adds it, false leaves it out, omitted follows the detection.

params.name: storage
params.description: docker only (--storage / --no-storage): MinIO S3 store + a one-shot bucket bootstrap (detected: an s3() storage driver). true adds it, false leaves it out, omitted follows the detection.

params.name: migrate
params.description: docker only (--migrate / --no-migrate): One-shot migrations service the app waits for: `denext migration up` with @denext/backend, else `denext job migrate` (detected: migrations/ + jobs/migrate.ts or @denext/backend). true adds it, false leaves it out, omitted follows the detection.

params.name: dashboard
params.description: docker only (--dashboard / --no-dashboard): The database dashboard (denext dashboard) on 127.0.0.1:3100, behind DASHBOARD_PASSWORD (on with Postgres). true adds it, false leaves it out, omitted follows the detection.

params.name: stack
params.description: docker only (--stack): every service the project needs, and Postgres regardless.

params.name: exposeDb
params.description: docker only (--expose-db): publish Postgres on 127.0.0.1:5432 (off: only the app reaches it).

params.name: dev
params.description: docker only (--dev): also write compose.dev.yml (denext dev on a bind mount).

params.name: dashboardLogs
params.description: docker only (--dashboard-logs): the dashboard's log relay, a service that mounts the Docker socket so the dashboard's Logs page can read the stack's logs.

params.name: port
params.description: docker only (--port): the port the app listens on (default 3000).

params.name: denoTag
params.description: docker only (--deno-tag): the denoland/deno image tag (default: this Deno's version).

tools.name: denext_doctor
tools.description: Run denext's project health check (config, app dir, route conformance) on a directory. Pass report: true for the full markdown health report — every route's conformance result and the last build's client bundle by chunk and role (no build is run).

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: .)

params.name: report
params.description: Return the full markdown health report instead of the check list

tools.name: denext_codemod
tools.description: Report (dry-run, no writes) the Next.js→denext import rewrites a codemod would make in a project directory.

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: .)

tools.name: denext_list_routes
tools.description: List an app's routes (pages + API route handlers) with their dynamic params, by scanning app/. Works without a running dev server.

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: .)

tools.name: denext_dev_logs
tools.description: Read the RUNNING dev server's recent events — server errors (with codeframes), server + browser console, completed requests (method/path/status/ms), and HMR events. Use it to see what actually happened at runtime. Requires `denext task dev` to be running.

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: .)

params.name: kind
params.description: Filter: "error", "console", "request", or "hmr" (default: all).

params.name: limit
params.description: Max events to return (default 50).

tools.name: denext_render
tools.description: Render a route (by `path`) or a component (by `component` + `props`) server-side — NO browser — and return the HTML + status. Use it to SEE what your change actually produces (or the error it throws). Runs against the project you launched the server in.

params.name: path
params.description: A route path to render, e.g. "/blog/hello".

params.name: component
params.description: A component module path (relative to dir) to render instead of a route.

params.name: props
params.description: Props for the component (with `component`).

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: .)

tools.name: denext_route_map
tools.description: Map everything that renders at a route path: the matched page + params, its layout and template chains (each tagged server/client), its loading/error/not-found boundaries and parallel slots, and any API route at the same path. Saves opening many files.

params.name: path
params.description: The route path to map, e.g. "/blog/hello".

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: .)

tools.name: denext_profile
tools.description: Build the app unminified, serve it, and profile a route in headless Chromium — CPU self-time by function + heap growth + a leak check. Use it to find WHERE runtime time goes and whether an interaction leaks. Pass `interact` (JS run in the page each iteration) to profile a re-render/interaction, and `budget` to gate a regression. Launches Chromium; slower than the browser-free tools.

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: .)

params.name: route
params.description: Route to profile (default "/").

params.name: interact
params.description: JavaScript evaluated in the page each iteration (e.g. globalThis.__burst(200)).

params.name: iterations
params.description: Repeat the interaction N times (default 1).

params.name: sampling
params.description: CPU sampling interval in µs (default 100).

params.name: minify
params.description: Profile a minified build (default: unminified).

params.name: budget
params.description: Optional budget: { maxHeapGrowthBytes?, maxLeakedBytes?, hotFns?: [{name, maxSelfPct}] }. A breach sets isError.

tools.name: denext_search_docs
tools.description: Search ALL of denext's docs, offline — every docs-site guide page (by section) plus the full API reference — by keyword or question. Returns the top sections/symbols with a `read:` ref, a denext.dev link and a snippet; pass the ref to denext_read_docs for the full text. Use it before writing code (and instead of fetching denext.dev) to find the right denext API, config key or recipe rather than guessing Next.js.

params.name: query
params.description: Keywords or a natural-language question, e.g. "read a session cookie".

params.name: kind
params.description: Restrict to guide pages (`guide`), API symbols (`api`), or both (`all`, default).

params.name: limit
params.description: Max results (default 8).

tools.name: denext_read_docs
tools.description: Read denext docs offline, as Markdown: a whole docs page by slug or URL ("desktop-runtime", "/docs/deployment-targets"), one section ("desktop#desktop-notifications"), or an API symbol's full docs ("api:denext/useApi", "api:denext/server/getSession"). An unknown page lists the closest matches and every page. Pair it with denext_search_docs, whose results carry the ref to pass here.

params.name: ref
params.description: Page slug or URL, "slug#anchor" for one section, or "api:<module>/<name>" for a symbol.

params.name: maxChars
params.description: Cap for a whole-page read (default 60000); past it the page is cut at a section boundary and the remaining sections are listed by ref.

tools.name: denext_index_codebase
tools.description: Build or refresh a searchable index of THIS project's own source code (honors the project's .gitignore). Optional — the query/definition/reference tools index on demand — but call it to warm the cache and see how many files were indexed.

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: current directory).

tools.name: denext_query_codebase
tools.description: Search THIS project's source code for the parts relevant to a task or concept, by keyword or natural-language question. Returns the top matching file locations with snippets — use it to find where something lives before editing.

params.name: query
params.description: What to look for, e.g. "where is auth handled".

params.name: limit
params.description: Max results (default 8).

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: current directory).

tools.name: denext_find_definition
tools.description: Find where a symbol (function, class, const, type, interface, enum) is declared in THIS project. Returns the declaration site(s), exported ones first.

params.name: symbol
params.description: The identifier to locate, e.g. `getSession`.

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: current directory).

tools.name: denext_find_references
tools.description: Find usages (call sites and other references) of a symbol across THIS project's source. Returns file locations with the matching line; results are capped.

params.name: symbol
params.description: The identifier to find references to.

params.name: limit
params.description: Max sites to list (default 50).

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: current directory).

tools.name: denext_component_tree
tools.description: Show the LIVE component tree of a running dev page — every component with its source location, badges and render count, as the in-page DevTools last pushed it. Use it to see what actually mounted. Requires `denext task dev` to be running AND the app open in a browser (the tree comes from the page, so it is a snapshot, and the answer says how old it is). Each call asks the open pages for a fresh tree over the dev server's reload stream and waits for it.

params.name: url
params.description: Which page's tree to read, e.g. `/blog/hello` (default: the most recent).

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: .)

params.name: filter
params.description: Only components whose name contains this (and their ancestors).

params.name: depth
params.description: How deep to render (default 12).

params.name: maxNodes
params.description: How many components to render (default 200).

tools.name: denext_why_render
tools.description: Explain why a component in a running dev page last re-rendered — which props, hooks and contexts changed, and how many renders it has done. Use it to chase a re-render loop or a missing memo. Requires `denext task dev` to be running AND the app open in a browser (the tree comes from the page, so it is a snapshot, and the answer says how old it is). Each call asks the open pages for a fresh tree over the dev server's reload stream and waits for it.

params.name: component
params.description: Component name, e.g. `Counter`.

params.name: url
params.description: Which page's tree to read, e.g. `/blog/hello` (default: the most recent).

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: .)

tools.name: denext_hook_state
tools.description: Read a component's live hook cells in a running dev page — each cell's name, the hook that produced it, its current value and its deps. Use it to see the state a component actually holds. Requires `denext task dev` to be running AND the app open in a browser (the tree comes from the page, so it is a snapshot, and the answer says how old it is). Each call asks the open pages for a fresh tree over the dev server's reload stream and waits for it.

params.name: component
params.description: Component name, e.g. `Counter`.

params.name: index
params.description: Show only this hook index (default: all).

params.name: url
params.description: Which page's tree to read, e.g. `/blog/hello` (default: the most recent).

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: .)

tools.name: denext_migrations
tools.description: The project's SQL migrations (migrations/ or supabase/migrations/) on its database (Postgres or SQLite): `list` shows local vs applied versions as JSON; `up` applies the pending ones (`to` stops at a version); `down` runs the newest applied ones' down scripts (`steps`, default 1). Pass dryRun to see what would run.

params.name: action
params.description: Default list

params.name: to
params.description: up: the last version to apply; down: keep it

params.name: steps
params.description: down: how many to revert (default 1)

params.name: dryRun
params.description: up / down: list what would run, run nothing

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: .)

params.name: dbUrl
params.description: Another database: a postgres:// URL or sqlite:<path> (default: the project's)

tools.name: denext_gen_types
tools.description: The database's TypeScript types (the `Database` type `supabase gen types typescript` writes) for the given schemas — tables, views, functions, enums. Needs @denext/backend with postgres.

params.name: schema
params.description: Comma-separated schemas (default public)

params.name: dir
params.description: Project directory (default: .)

params.name: dbUrl
params.description: Another database: a postgres:// URL or sqlite:<path> (default: the project's)

params.name: apply

params.name: timeoutMs
